reason: I've never heard of this store and I'd be spending $360 on a light I can't see in person. I can usually find something close at a big retailer with a promo code and faster delivery.
objection: 10 to 12 business days is a long wait for a light, and if I change my mind I pay return shipping on a bulky fixture. Unknown store, so I have no idea about quality or if they'd back me up.
would_change_my_mind: Real customer photos and reviews, plus free return shipping or a faster delivery date. Bulk pricing for my two rentals would get me to take a second look.
